title: Threat Hunter
description:
**Role Description**
Role Summary We are looking for a Threat Hunter to join our Cyber Security team and proactively identify, analyze, and mitigate advanced threats targeting the bank's IT and digital banking infrastructure. The candidate will use FortiRecon for external attack surface and digital risk monitoring, and interpret threat hunting reports and vulnerability advisories to drive proactive hunts using Splunk and Microsoft Sentinel, in line with RBI cybersecurity guidelines and industry best practices. Key Responsibilities Conduct proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunting across endpoints, network, cloud, and core banking-adjacent systems using Splunk and Microsoft Sentinel. Monitor and act on intelligence from FortiRecon (external attack surface management, brand/phishing protection, digital risk monitoring) to identify exposure relevant to a financial services target profile. Interpret threat intelligence reports, vulnerability advisories (CVE bulletins, OEM/vendor advisories), and sector-specific s (CERT-In, RBI/IDRBT, FS-ISAC) to build hunting hypotheses and prioritize action. Develop hunting playbooks, KQL/SPL queries, and use cases mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, with emphasis on threats relevant to banking (phishing, credential theft, fraud-linked malware, ATM/payment switch threats, insider risk). Correlate findings across EDR, network, cloud, and identity logs to validate threats and hand off confirmed incidents to the Incident Response team. Support timely reporting/escalation in line with CERT-In incident reporting timelines and internal regulatory obligations. Collaborate with Vulnerability Management, SOC, and IT teams to close detection and patching gaps surfaced during hunts. Maintain documentation of hunting methodology, findings, and detection coverage improvements for internal and regulatory audits (RBI IS Audit, VAPT reviews). Stay current on threat actor campaigns and TTPs targeting Indian financial institutions. Required Skills & Experience 3–6 years in a Threat Intelligence/Threat Hunting role, ideally within BFSI or a regulated industry. Hands-on experience with FortiRecon or a similar EASM/Digital Risk Protection platform. Strong proficiency in Splunk (SPL) and Microsoft Sentinel (KQL, analytics rules, workbooks). Ability to read and act on vulnerability advisories (CVSS scoring, exploitability, patch prioritization) and threat intel reports. Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and its application to hunt hypotheses. Familiarity with EDR tools (Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, etc.). Understanding of Windows/Linux internals, network protocols, and cloud security (Azure/AWS). Awareness of RBI Cyber Security Framework for Banks, CERT-In guidelines, and PCI-DSS (a plus). Certifications: GCTI, GCFA, CEH, CompTIA Security+, Microsoft SC-200, or equivalent. Scripting skills (Python/PowerShell) for hunt automation. Prior experience in a bank, NBFC, or fintech SOC environment. Exposure to fraud/payment security use cases.

Threat Hunting, Threat Intelligence, Vulnerability Management, Splunk, Cloud Security, CrowdStrike, Incident Response, PowerShell

We provide a unified and scalable operating model covering service management, platform operations, governance, compliance, and modernisation—so actuarial teams can focus on business outcomes with confidence in platform reliability and control.

Teams work alongside global partners to support run operations, change, and transformation initiatives, contributing to scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency across the actuarial ecosystem.

* Global collaboration – Work with diverse, highly skilled teams across Hyderabad, Barcelona, and multiple global locations

*If you want to operate at the intersection of release excellence and agile delivery leadership—working on platforms that truly matter to Zurich’s financial reporting and regulatory outcomes—Actuary IT Solutions is the place to do it.*
**Role Purpose**
The Release Manager & Scrum Master is responsible for orchestrating the end-to-end release lifecycle for the ACE actuarial platform while simultaneously leading agile ceremonies and delivery rhythm for a geo-dispersed team. **Release Management**

* Own the end-to-end release process for the ACE platform: planning, scheduling, coordination, and deployment across complex, multi-environment, multi-component releases.
* Define and maintain the release calendar, change windows, and release trains in alignment with business and regulatory timelines.
* Coordinate release readiness across Engineering, Testing, and Business stakeholders—ensuring sign-off gates, test evidence, and change management processes are completed before every deployment.
* Manage hotfixes, emergency releases, and production incidents with structured communication and minimal disruption.
* Maintain a clear audit trail of all releases through Azure DevOps, ensuring traceability from work item to deployment.
* Act as the single point of accountability for release quality, risk, and go/no-go decisions.
* Produce and maintain a complete release artefact pack for every deployment — including release notes, test evidence sign-off, go/no-go decision record, change request documentation, and deployment confirmations — structured to satisfy internal audit and Group Reporting governance requirements.

**Scrum Master & Agile Delivery**

* Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and backlog refinement sessions.
* Remove impediments, protect the team from scope creep, and ensure sprint commitments are realistic and delivered.
* Track and report on velocity, sprint health, and delivery metrics—escalating risks proactively to stakeholders.

**Azure DevOps (ADO) Ownership**

* Configure and maintain ADO work item hierarchies, sprint boards, and reporting dashboards for senior stakeholder visibility.
* Ensure end-to-end traceability from requirements to test evidence to deployment through ADO.
* Drive adoption of ADO best practices across the team and onboard new team members to ADO workflows.

**Stakeholder Communication & Governance**

* Provide regular, clear release and delivery status updates to global stakeholders across Hyderabad, Barcelona, and Switzerland.

**AI-First & Continuous Improvement**

* Apply an AI-first mindset to release and delivery processes: use AI tools to improve sprint reporting, release documentation, risk identification, and status communications.
* Continuously identify and drive process improvements to reduce release cycle time, increase predictability, and improve sprint delivery rates.
* Act as a critical thinker: validate AI outputs and apply professional judgement before adoption.

**Skills & Experience**
**Required Experience**

* Minimum 7 years of experience in Release Management, Delivery Management, or Agile Scrum roles.
* Proven experience managing releases for large, complex enterprise applications with multiple integrated components.
* Strong hands-on experience as a Scrum Master on a delivery team—not just a supporting role, but as the primary facilitator and impediment remover.

**Technical Skills**

* Experience with release tooling and deployment coordination (CI/CD pipelines, change management processes, ITSM tools).

**About the Role**

The Principal Outcome Manager owns business outcomes for our clients — not just projects. This is a senior consulting role that combines deep technology fluency, strong business judgment and disciplined delivery leadership.

It is not a traditional project manager role. The Outcome Manager agrees with the client up-front on what success looks like in measurable terms, leads the team that delivers it, tracks the outcome continuously, and stands behind the realized result.

In one line: agree the outcome, deliver the outcome, and make sure both the client and Tezo win
**.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Discovery and outcome definition**

* Run discovery workshops with client business and technology leaders to uncover the real problem.
* Translate the client's ambition into 2– 4 measurable KPIs with clear baselines and targets.
* Document and sign off the outcome, the measurement method and the review cadence with the client.

**2. Shaping the engagement**

* Partner with sales and pricing to structure a fair, outcome-linked commercial that protects margin and gives the client real upside.
* Identify risks early and decide — with leadership — whether to pursue, reshape or decline the deal.
* Co-own the Statement of Work, ensuring every outcome term is unambiguous and measurable.

**3. Execution and delivery**

* Build the right cross-functional pod (architects, engineering leads, data scientists, analysts) and set the operating cadence.
* Drive day-to-day delivery through the leads. You do not write code, but you always know whether the work is on track to the outcome — and intervene early when it is not.
* Manage scope, risks, dependencies and change with discipline.

**4. Outcome tracking and realization**

* Stand up a simple outcome dashboard for each engagement: live KPI values against baseline and target, with leading indicators.
* Run a weekly internal review and a regular client-facing outcome review. Convert lagging KPIs into corrective actions with owners and dates.
* Close each engagement with a short outcome memo: what was committed, what was delivered, what the business impact was, what to repeat next time.

**5. Stakeholder consulting and communication**

* Act as a trusted advisor to client business and technology sponsors — bring point of view, not just status updates.
* Translate fluently between the CIO/CTO conversation (architecture, data, AI, technical risk) and the CXO conversation (revenue, cost, customer experience, time-to-market).
* Manage escalations and disagreements directly; protect the relationship and the outcome at the same time.
* Identify the next outcome and help grow the account.

**6. People and team leadership**

* Lead the engagement pod with clarity on outcome and decision rights.

**Experience :**

* 10 –15 years of overall experience, currently working in a senior consulting role.

We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  
**About The Role**
Signant Health is recruiting an IT Delivery Lead to give every significant IT delivery a single, accountable owner from approval through to a compliant go-live. Working within IT’s lean, high-tempo delivery model, the IT Delivery Lead takes end-to-end ownership of automation and Ai delivery — with particular accountability for the cross-boundary work (dependencies, compliance sequencing, decisions, escalation and continuity) that keeps a delivery on track in a regulated, GxP environment.
  
  
This is a delivery and coordination role, not a build role: engineering owns the technical work and the initiative roadmap sits with the Sponsor. The IT Delivery Lead owns whether a delivery is genuinely ready to ship — sequencing compliance so it never becomes the bottleneck, confirming dependencies before dates are committed, driving decisions and approvals to closure, and keeping the audit trail complete. It will suit a delivery professional energised by making complex, cross-functional work land in a controlled environment, who is also fluent in how AI and automation are governed and delivered responsibly.
  
  
**Location: Hyderabad/Bangalore/Noida**
**Work mode: Remote**
**Years of experience: 3-6 Years**
**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function**

* Delivery ownership — hold a single delivery accountable end to end through the IT SDLC; run its gates (day-one AI-vs-automation classification, Team Confirmation, Go/No-Go, release and closure); confirm the delivery is genuinely ready to go live.
* Boundary & dependency management — maintain the dependency and change-freeze register; confirm feasibility with dependency owners before dates are committed; drive decisions, approvals and escalations to closure; ensure a named deputy for every gate approver.
* Compliance & validation orchestration — sequence GxP compliance so it is never the bottleneck; own the tier-appropriate deliverable set (GxP risk determination, Validation Plan, Process Risk Assessment/FMEA, test evidence, release notification, validation summary) to completion and approval; protect the audit trail.
* Release management — own the release runbook; route production change through the change-management process, including CAB review for high-impact change; sequence sign-offs; confirm hypercare and monitoring ownership before go-live.
* Team cadence — facilitate the daily standup; uphold Jira hygiene and a shared Definition of Done; coordinate UAT and demos.
* Risk & continuous improvement — maintain the project risk register; run delivery retrospectives; maintain shared templates and the delivery playbook so learning is retained in the model.

**Knowledge, Skills & Attributes**
Essential:
  
  

* Degree-level education or equivalent professional experience.
* Delivery, project or agile certification (e.g. Scrum, PRINCE2, PMP, ITIL) desirable.
* Excellent stakeholder management and the ability to influence, coordinate and drive work to closure without direct authority.
* Confident facilitation of agile ceremonies and disciplined use of Jira and delivery tooling.
* Working knowledge of AI and automation governance — and comfort working with AI-enabled delivery tooling.
* Highly organised and detail-oriented, with a habit of surfacing risks and dependencies early.

**Desirable:**

* Proven delivery or project-management track record taking technology change to production in a regulated (preferably GxP / life-sciences) environment.
* Strong compliance-sequencing and validation awareness (CSA / GAMP 5, change management) with audit-grade documentation discipline.
* Experience delivering automation / RPA and AI-enabled solutions.
* Familiarity with GxP computerised system validation and quality frameworks (21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ICH E6(R3)).
* Data literacy and experience resolving cross-system data-readiness issues.

**Why Signant Health?**
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
  
We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
  
If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
  
  
At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. description:
**Job Description**
**UX Designer**
Summary/objective
  
  
isolved builds Human Capital Management software that millions of people use to get paid, manage time off, enroll in benefits, and run HR for their companies. The work touches essential parts of people's lives, so the experience needs to be clear, efficient, and trustworthy. You'll drive evidence-based product decisions for the isolved platform, working alongside engineers and product managers as the designer for the experiences you're assigned. You plan the research, shape the direction, and carry the work from problem framing through to what ships, using design thinking methods to ground decisions in how people actually behave rather than how we assume they do.The isolved platform is broad and interconnected. The designers who do well here can design a feature and also see how it ripples through the rest of the product: what it touches, what it changes, and what has to stay consistent.
  
  
Core Job Duties
  
  

* End-to-end experience design: discovery, flows, wireframes, high-fidelity screens, prototypes, and handoff
* Choose the right research method for the question at hand, run it, and turn raw findings into insights the team can act on. Synthesis and storytelling matter as much as the research itself
* Bring product and engineering into the research as it happens so decisions are shared, not pitched after the fact
* Design with the isolved design system and build on it, contributing new components and patterns when your work exposes a gap
* Facilitate workshops and working sessions with stakeholders, with clear goals and tangible outcomes
* Present work to the design team and stakeholders, give and take critique well, and iterate quickly
* Use AI tools as part of your everyday workflow: research planning, synthesis, competitive analysis, exploration, and documentation
* Design for accessibility and for the range of devices and contexts our users work in

Job Complexity
  
  
Having wide-ranging experience, uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex data platform issues creatively and effectively. Serves as the hands-on, go-to expert for isolved's data platform infrastructure, administration, and pipeline operations. Some barriers to entry exist at this level (e.g., peer or architecture review).

* Comfort with the full UX toolkit: research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, and prototyping

Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.
  
  
Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.
  
  
**Senior Software Engineer, Salesforce**
As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll play a pivotal role in designing, building, and delivering innovative technology solutions that fuel Empower’s mission to help millions of customers achieve financial freedom. You’ll develop high-quality software that adheres to modern design patterns and architectural principles—balancing technical excellence with practical delivery.
  
  
This role combines hands-on engineering with leadership and mentorship responsibilities, helping shape both our systems and our people.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design, build, test, and support scalable, resilient software aligned with Empower’s business and architectural strategies.
* Develop and enhance complex applications, introducing new features and improving existing systems for performance, scalability, security, and maintainability.
* Partner with other developers and architects to evolve our codebase, tools, and development processes.
* Provide expert technical support and guidance to end users and internal partners.
* Contribute to and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines, improving delivery efficiency and reliability.
* Write automated and unit/functional tests and follow modern engineering practices to ensure code quality and maintain high test coverage.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues with speed and precision.
* Apply Empower’s security controls and disaster recovery principles in all design and implementation efforts.
* Drive application resiliency through thoughtful design and robust engineering.
* Create prototypes and proof-of-concepts that inspire innovation and shape future technical direction.
* Design pragmatic, scalable solutions with clear trade-offs and articulate them effectively to stakeholders.
* Produce clear, detailed design documentation to support implementation and estimation.
* Contribute to long-term architectural vision emphasizing simplicity, scalability, and maintainability.
* Collaborate with cross-functional, geographically distributed teams to deliver customer value.
* Model and promote best practices across coding standards, architecture, and process — coaching and mentoring peers and junior engineers.
* Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies.
* Support Lead Developers in oversight, training, and technical guidance of the team.
* Perform other duties as needed.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* 2+ years or professional experience developing solutions in Salesforce Sales, Service, or Industry Clouds (e.g., Financial Services, Health, Manufacturing).
* Strong grasp of object-oriented programming principles and experience with at least one OOP language (Java, Python, etc.).
* Proficiency in working with JSON and XML.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and iterative delivery.
* Continuous learning mindset with a passion for staying current with emerging technologies.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills — able to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
* Experience deploying updates, diagnosing production issues, and implementing integrations that meet customer needs.

**What Will Set You Apart**

* 2+ years of Salesforce Omnistudio or Financial Services Cloud experience.
* 4+ years of hands-on OOP development experience with modern frameworks and tools.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field (preferred).
* Experience with or interest in OmniStudio, Copado, and Financial Services Cloud.
* Practical experience designing and building scalable solutions for complex enterprise systems and business challenges.
* Strong knowledge of modern integration methods.

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications of the job. The employer has the right to revise this job description at any time. You will be evaluated in part based on your performance of the responsibilities and/or tasks listed in this job description. You may be required perform other duties that are not included on this job description. The job description is not a contract for employment, and either you or the employer may terminate employment at any time, for any reason, as per terms and conditions of your employment contract.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
**About Revun**
Revun is building a next-generation software platform designed to modernize how property owners, property managers, brokerages, maintenance providers, service professionals, and real estate organizations operate.
  
  
The platform combines CRM, leasing, maintenance, accounting, payments, communications, workflow automation, compliance, reporting, AI, integrations, and stakeholder portals into a single operating platform.
  
  
Our goal is not to build another collection of disconnected software tools. We are building an operational platform that simplifies complex business processes, reduces manual work, improves visibility, and helps organizations operate more efficiently.
  
  
The product is already underway, and we are now looking for a strong product designer who can help turn a complex platform into an intuitive, professional, scalable, and commercially ready user experience.
  
  
**About The Role**
Revun is hiring a
**Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)**
to lead the design of our web and mobile product experience.
  
  
This is not a graphic design role, and it is not a role focused only on creating attractive screens.
  
  
We are looking for someone who understands how to design real software products, including complex SaaS platforms, marketplace applications, dashboards, workflows, portals, mobile apps, and multi-user systems.
  
  
You will work closely with leadership, engineering, and product stakeholders to simplify complex workflows, improve usability, create scalable design systems, and help prepare the platform for commercial launch.
  
  
The successful candidate must be able to think through product flows, user journeys, permissions, edge cases, responsive layouts, information hierarchy, and design handoff — not just visual styling.
  
  
You should also be comfortable using AI tools to improve your design process, speed up research and ideation, organize complex requirements, generate UX copy, explore layout options, create user flows, and improve documentation while still applying your own product judgment.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Please submit your
**resume and portfolio**
for consideration.
  
  
Your portfolio should include examples of real product-design work, such as user flows, dashboards, complex interfaces, mobile screens, design systems, marketplace workflows, SaaS platforms, or similar product examples.
  
  
Candidates with only branding, landing pages, social media graphics, or marketing websites will not be the strongest fit for this role.
  
  
Qualified candidates will be invited to complete a pre-recorded video interview 24-48 hours after applying as the next step in the hiring process.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design user-friendly web and mobile experiences for a complex SaaS and marketplace-style platform
* Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, and developer-ready UI specifications
* Design workflows for multiple user types, including internal users, property owners, tenants, vendors, service providers, partners, and administrators
* Translate complex business processes into simple, intuitive product experiences
* Work closely with leadership and engineering to turn product vision into clear, usable, buildable designs
* Improve the overall information architecture, navigation, dashboard structure, forms, portals, workflows, and mobile experience
* Design and maintain scalable design systems, reusable components, UI patterns, and style standards
* Create clean, professional, modern, and consistent product interfaces
* Identify gaps, edge cases, confusing user flows, and areas where the product experience can be simplified
* Collaborate with developers to ensure designs are technically feasible and implemented accurately
* Review builds and provide design QA feedback before release
* Use AI tools responsibly to speed up research, ideation, UX writing, documentation, design exploration, and workflow development
* Validate AI-assisted design outputs through human judgment, user needs, business requirements, and product logic
* Support commercial launch readiness by ensuring the platform is easy to understand, easy to use, and visually consistent

**Required Experience**

* 6+ years of UX/UI, Product Design, or related digital product design experience
* Experience designing complex SaaS platforms, marketplace applications, CRM systems, workflow platforms, fintech products, operational dashboards, or other multi-role software products
* Strong experience designing both web and mobile product experiences
* Strong Figma skills, including components, Auto Layout, variants, design systems, prototyping, and developer handoff
* Experience designing dashboards, forms, tables, workflows, portals, user profiles, settings, notifications, and role-based user experiences
* Experience working directly with engineers and product stakeholders
* Strong understanding of user flows, information architecture, interaction design, usability, visual hierarchy, responsive design, and design systems
* Experience using AI tools to support design work, UX writing, research synthesis, user-flow creation, wireframing, prototyping, or product documentation
* Ability to explain design decisions clearly and connect them to user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility
* Strong attention to detail and ability to produce polished, developer-ready designs
* Strong written and spoken English
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment

**Strongly Preferred Experience**

* Experience designing marketplace platforms or multi-sided products
* Experience with property technology, real estate platforms, maintenance platforms, field-service software, booking platforms, fintech, CRM systems, or enterprise workflow software
* Experience designing products with multiple user types and role-based permissions
* Experience designing payment, transaction, vendor, booking, service-request, or dashboard workflows
* Experience designing AI-powered product features or AI-assisted workflows
* Experience improving an existing product rather than only designing from scratch
* Experience working in startups or fast-moving product environments
* Experience with usability testing, product analytics, user research, or customer feedback loops
* Experience creating design systems from the ground up

AI Expectations
  
  
We are looking for a designer who uses AI as a productivity tool, not as a substitute for product judgment.
  
  
**You Should Be Comfortable Using AI To Help With**

* UX research organization
* User-flow exploration
* Wireframe ideation
* Interface-copy options
* Product requirement organization
* Edge-case discovery
* Design-system documentation
* Competitive research summaries
* Prototype concepts
* Usability-test summaries
* Design iteration

However, you must still review, validate, and improve all AI-assisted work yourself. Final design decisions must be based on user needs, product logic, business goals, usability, accessibility, and technical feasibility.
  
  
The Person We Are Looking For
  
  
You are a true product thinker.
  
  
You do not just make screens look good — you understand how people actually use software.
  
  
You can take a complicated workflow and make it feel clear, simple, and logical.
  
  
You are comfortable designing for different types of users who each need different information, permissions, dashboards, and actions.
  
  
You think through edge cases, empty states, errors, mobile responsiveness, role-based access, data-heavy screens, and developer handoff.
  
  
You are confident working with engineers and leadership, and you can explain why a design decision matters.
  
  
You are also comfortable using AI to work faster, explore more options, and improve your process, while still owning the quality of the final product.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  

* The platform becomes easier to understand and easier to use
* Core workflows are redesigned with clearer user journeys
* Web and mobile experiences become more consistent and polished
* Developers receive clear, complete, buildable design specifications
* The design system becomes scalable and reusable
* Product screens feel modern, professional, and commercially ready
* Users can complete important tasks with less confusion and fewer unnecessary steps
* AI is used responsibly to improve speed, quality, and documentation
* Design work directly supports product launch and long-term platform growth

**Compensation**
The monthly compensation range for this role is:
  
  
CAD $24,000–$36,000 annually
  
  
Final compensation will depend on experience, product-design depth, SaaS and marketplace experience, AI-assisted workflow capability, communication skills, and ability to work independently.
